title: identity.user.deleted.v1
description: A user's account was deleted: yc-identity anonymised it and revoked its tokens. Starts the GDPR cascade (ADR-005): every service holding the user's data removes it or replaces user_id with the pseudonym, then publishes platform.gdpr.cascade_completed.v1.

pseudonym.description: A random UUID that replaces user_id wherever a record is kept, so later events about those records still validate. Only yc-identity can map it back to the user.

requested_by.description: Whether the user deleted their own account or a system admin deleted it.
